zapdos-skill-charge-beam.name: Charge Beam
zapdos-skill-charge-beam.description: New skill: a quick electric beam at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 45).

zapdos-static.name: Static
zapdos-static.description: Its hits on adjacent foes Paralyze them for 1 turn.

zapdos-first-strike.name: First Strike
zapdos-first-strike.description: +20% damage against foes at full HP.

zapdos-skill-thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
zapdos-skill-thunderbolt.description: New skill: a bolt at range (Power 60) that Paralyzes for 1 turn.

zapdos-skill-charge.name: Charge
zapdos-skill-charge.description: New skill: stores power and becomes Focused for 2 turns.

zapdos-storm-rider.name: Storm Rider
zapdos-storm-rider.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

zapdos-quick-charge.name: Quick Charge
zapdos-quick-charge.description: Its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster (minimum 1).

zapdos-skill-zap-cannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapdos-skill-zap-cannon.description: New skill: a huge electric orb at range (Power 90) that Paralyzes.

zapdos-skill-hurricane.name: Hurricane
zapdos-skill-hurricane.description: New skill: a storm hits a foe up to 3 hexes away and pushes it 2 hexes (Power 90).

zapdos-insulated.name: Insulated
zapdos-insulated.description: Cannot be Paralyzed or Slowed; +1 Sp. Def.

zapdos-recharge.name: Recharge
zapdos-recharge.description: Heals 4% of its max HP each turn.

zapdos-skill-thunder.name: Thunder
zapdos-skill-thunder.description: New skill: lightning strikes an area 2-3 hexes away (Power 85) and Paralyzes.

zapdos-skill-volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
zapdos-skill-volt-switch.description: New skill: a bolt at range (Power 70) that ends its engagement.

zapdos-storm-herald.name: Storm Herald
zapdos-storm-herald.description: +1 extra Bond when it knocks out a foe; +2 Speed.

zapdos-thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
zapdos-thunderstorm.description: Capstone. +25% vs Paralyzed foes; a knockout resets its skill cooldowns.

zapdos-storm-crown.name: Storm Crown
zapdos-storm-crown.description: Capstone. Team gets +1 max and starting Bond; its Bond moves cost 1 less.
